# Kristi Achilleos

> Engineering leader and founding engineer based in Cyprus, working internationally. I build products, and the teams behind them. Open to engineering leadership roles, senior and lead engineering roles and contracts from December 2026.

## About

- Role: engineering leader and hands-on founding engineer.
- Looking for: engineering leadership (engineering manager, growing towards head of engineering); also open to senior or lead engineer roles and contract build engagements.
- Drivers: helping developers grow into the best version of themselves and be happy at work.
- Experience: 10+ years across software engineering, engineering management and founding-engineer roles.
- Highlights: led the engineering team behind a product that reached £1M+ ARR (Unibuddy); split a monolith team into autonomous squads, with development velocity up 30% and incidents resolved 40% faster and 0% regrettable attrition (Playroll); built an AI-native platform from scratch as a founding engineer (Familiar).
- Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, React Native / Expo, AWS, AI agents.
- Location: Cyprus (EET, UTC+2). Remote-first, working with teams across time zones.
